name: inferno-core
description: Core library for the Inferno Framework

paragraphs: Inferno Core is the central library of the Inferno Framework that allows you to write, execute, and distribute executable conformance tests for the HL7® FHIR® standard standard. Inferno Core isn't built to be used alone; it is imported as a library into Inferno Test Kits, which are web-based testing applications that target specific data exchange use cases enabled by FHIR.
To learn how to use the Inferno Framework and Inferno Core to develop your own Inferno Test Kit, visit Inferno Framework Documentation: Getting Started for Inferno Test Writers.
Inferno Core is a Ruby library used to create Ruby-based test applications (called Inferno Test Kits) and provides features useful for writing and executing FHIR API tests:
features: Inferno DSL: A domain specific language for authoring FHIR API tests that
API, Web and CLI Interfaces: Multiple interfaces for executing tests and
Test Reuse: Methods for reusing tests within a project or from other projects
include the use of additional standards beyond FHIR,
have large specifications that could benefit from Ruby's meta-programming
